title_ja: 当社グループが委託する生命保険募集代理店におけるランサムウェア被害について
title_en: Ransomware damage at a life insurance agency commissioned by our group
summary_en: On 5 March 2025, Fukoku Mutual Life and Fukoku Shinrai Life said that Hoken Minaoshi Honpo Group, a life insurance agency that sells their products on commission, had suffered a ransomware attack. Their customers' information may have been leaked, though no leak has been confirmed so far. The agency is still investigating, and the insurers ask customers not to respond to suspicious contacts. The agency issued its own release on 25 February 2025.

title_ja: 一時払終身保険「グッとアップ」の発売および終身保険特約・介護保障特約＜終身型＞の保険料率の改定について
title_en: Launch of single-premium whole life insurance 'Gutto Up' and revision of premium rates for the whole life insurance rider and nursing care benefit rider (lifetime type)
summary_en: Fukoku Mutual Life announced on 7 March 2025 that it will launch "Guttoappu", a single-premium whole life policy with dividends and no health questions. The policy goes on sale on 1 April 2025 at a 1.50% assumed interest rate, and it ends a pause in underwriting single-premium products that began in July 2016. From 2 April 2025 it will also raise the assumed interest rate on the whole life rider and the whole-life nursing care rider of its "Mirai no Tobira" product from 0.40% to 1.50%. In the document's examples, this cuts premiums by roughly 17–36%.

title_ja: 当社元営業職員の逮捕について
title_en: Arrest of a former sales representative of our company
summary_en: Fukoku Mutual Life Insurance announced on 8 July 2026 that Tottori Prefectural Police had arrested two of its former sales representatives, both women in their 40s, on suspicion of fraud. The two worked at an office under the Tottori branch. The company says they forged claim documents on medical insurance policies held by themselves or their family members and took benefit payments, starting in December 2022 for one and April 2023 for the other. The company says it is cooperating with the investigation and will work to prevent a recurrence.
